subject.title: Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity

question: Should OpenClaw core recognize `openclaw-even-g2-node` with `platform: "even-hub"` and `deviceFamily: "glasses"` as a canonical native setup-code bootstrap client that receives the existing bounded operator handoff?
rationale: The code path is narrow and tested, but the choice changes a Gateway auth trust boundary and creates a durable wire-level identity for an external glasses app; automation cannot own that product/security contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow identity after mergeability refresh
options.body: Accept the proposed `openclaw-even-g2-node` / `even-hub` / `glasses` contract, require exact-head mergeability to be refreshed, and leave app placement and command policy to the related issue.

options.title: Rename or generalize before merge
options.body: Ask the contributor to switch to the maintainer-preferred durable client id and refresh proof against the renamed external app before merging.

options.title: Keep the integration external for now
options.body: Do not add a core bootstrap identity yet; keep Even Hub on generic node/plugin paths until maintainers choose a first-party or plugin ownership model.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow identity after mergeability refresh
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed `openclaw-even-g2-node` / `even-hub` / `glasses` contract, require exact-head mergeability to be refreshed, and leave app placement and command policy to the related issue.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` is the strongest routing candidate from maintainer role plus recent Gateway auth/protocol history.
